company_info.industry_info: Software and cloud computing. Autodesk is a leader in design and engineering software, building cloud platforms used globally. The company serves the Architecture, Engineering, Construction & Operations (AECO) sectors, as well as media and entertainment industries.
company_info.recent_news: In January 2026, Autodesk underwent restructuring with approximately 7% of its global workforce (about 1,000 jobs) reduced. This followed a 2025 layoff of 1,350 employees (9% of workforce). The company is focused on AI and cloud computing expansion. Recent fiscal 2026 results showed strong international growth with EMEA revenues up 25% YoY and APAC up 16%. In June 2026, Autodesk committed $350 million over three years for AI skills training and workforce development.
company_info.company_culture: Autodesk is recognized for its inclusive and supportive workplace culture. According to Glassdoor (4,647 reviews), the company has a 4.0/5 employee rating with 80% of employees recommending it to a friend. Employees rate work-life balance at 4.2/5. The culture is described as warm, collaborative, and inclusive. The company emphasizes meaningful work that helps build a better world and has a focus on diversity and belonging.
company_info.any_related_information: Autodesk is headquartered in San Francisco, California (moved from San Rafael in 2022). The company has a strong focus on next-generation cloud platforms and is actively investing in AI-powered technologies. The role is part of their Consumption platform initiative. As a publicly traded company (ADSK), Autodesk reported $6.78 billion in revenue and $1.12 billion in net income for fiscal 2026. The company invests heavily in R&D ($1.64 billion in 2026) and is positioning itself as a leader in agentic AI for design and manufacturing.
